title: So as noon day sun Settles tilted toward Heavens A glisten Kisses Treetops littered Frozen tips On winds kiss As degrees of heat grow Between us Once
summary: So as noon day sun Settles tilted toward Heavens A glisten Kisses Treetops littered Frozen tips On winds kiss As degrees of heat grow Between us Once again I reconsider Warmth of winter's Hug #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
So as noon day
sun
Settles
tilted toward
Heavens
A glisten
Kisses
Treetops
littered
Frozen tips
On winds kiss
As degrees
of heat grow
Between us
Once again
I reconsider
Warmth of winter's
Hug
#smallpoems
